text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, news of Narita Brian's injury is 
reported. Hishi Amazon visits her to offer 
encouragement, telling her, "I'll be 
waiting at the Arima Kinen."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before long, Narita Brian was discharged 
from the hospital. She asks Hishi Amazon 
why she's so obsessed with her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon replied that no matter how 
far ahead that back got, it made her 
determined to chase it down and pass 
it—that's the kind of back it was.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian looked convinced. She, too, 
had a back she yearned to surpass...
